notes:
- TuneBridge 2.0 works with Fenix: zone groups, source selection, transport and now playing.
- Scenes and schedules can be created and recalled from TuneBridge; scene schedules can be edited on the Schedule page.
- A zone turned on from TuneBridge or Mirage now starts on the first free music player, never on an auxiliary source.
- Auxiliary sources: play/pause and track position now update in all apps, and the TuneBridge mini player shows their track and artwork.
- Switching a player from one radio station to another no longer leaves the old station's track info on screen.
- Calm Radio channels in Recently Played play again, and the current track stays on screen.
- TuneIn: song artwork is shown when available, otherwise the station logo; station logos are no longer replaced by song pictures.
- "Unknown" is no longer shown as the track name for radio stations.
- Auxiliary sources keep working after the configuration is rebuilt.
